summary: The customer called to close his internet and landline account because he is relocating abroad. The agent verified his identity, confirmed there were no early termination fees, explained the final bill process, and provided options for returning the router. The account closure was successfully scheduled for the end of the day.

evidence.text: Ahlan wa sahlan, welcome to Apex Telecom, my name is Rami, kif bage’dek yom?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained a polite, professional, and welcoming tone throughout the call.

evidence.text: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that you want to disconnect,momken a’ref the reason for closing?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent expressed polite regret upon hearing the customer wanted to disconnect and offered well wishes for his relocation.

evidence.text: Once I submit the request now, it will be scheduled for closure effective end of day today, w el-final invoice will be generated in 48 hours.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent fully resolved the customer's request by scheduling the account closure and answering all questions regarding bills and equipment.

evidence.text: The router, meshshān el-device, you can drop it off at any of our branches before you travel, aw momken we send a courier to pick it up, bas el-branch is faster.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent explained options clearly and concisely, ensuring the customer understood the router return process.

evidence.text: Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent properly checked for additional needs, wished the customer well, and concluded the call professionally.

evidence.text: Yes, exactly as you said, el-commitment khalas ended last month, so there are zero termination fees, bas just the current month usage.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent accurately verified the contract status and correctly informed the customer about the absence of termination fees.

evidence.text: Akid, we can process the cancellation for you, bas I just need to verify some details meshshān security.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent correctly followed verification procedures by asking for the customer's full name and account number before discussing account details.
